sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ऋषेः परमधार्मिकम् ।तद्रामः प्रतिजग्राह मुनेराभरणं वरम् ।। ७.७६.४७ ॥
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā ṛṣeḥ paramadhārmikam ।tadrāmaḥ pratijagrāha munerābharaṇaṁ varam ।। 7.76.47 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that most righteous speech of the sage, Rama accepted that excellent ornament from the sage.
